entityName: National University of Science and Technology Politehnica Bucharest
entityDescription:
NUST POLITEHNICA Bucharest is the oldest and most prestigious engineer school in Romania. Its traditions are related to the establishment, in 1818, by Gheorghe Lazăr, of the first higher technical school with teaching in Romanian, at the Saint Sava Abbey in Bucharest. In 1832, it was reorganized into the St. Sava College.
On 1 October 1864, The School of Bridges and Roads, Mines and Architecture was established, which becomes, on 30 October 1867,The School of Bridges, Roads and Mines, with a duration of 5 years. Under the leadership of Gheorghe Duca, on 1 April 1881, the institution acquires a new structure, under the name of The National School of Bridges and Roads; on 10 June 1920, the Politehnica School of Bucharest was founded, with four departments: Electromechanics, Civil Engineering, Mines and Metallurgy, Industrial Section. From November 1920 the name changes to POLITEHNICA of Bucharest.
On 3 August 1948, the Polytechnic Institute of Bucharest was founded, which initially included 4 faculties and in which, since 1950, have appeared most of the current faculties. Based on the resolution of the Senate of November 1992, the Polytechnic Institute of Bucharest became University POLITEHNICA of Bucharest.
After the merger with the University of Pitesti, in 2023, the university was named the National University of Science and Technology Politehnica Bucharest.
NUSTPB assumes the mission to train specialists in different technical fields that are able to use valuable scientific, technical and cultural knowledge, to contribute to the technological, economic and social-cultural progress of the Romanian society and the contemporary world. NUSTPB ensures a performant education, developed and perfected through a complex research activity, continuing the tradition of the Polytechnic School of Bucharest, according to the exigencies and the means offered by the modern information society. It aims to create a new technical university profile, which promotes forms of training adapted to the requirements of a competing society, subject to the integration process in the European and international community.Its main mission is to train an engineer capable of adapting to the requirements of market economy and new technologies, with an economic and managerial knowledge and promote the principles of sustainable development and environmental protection.
The University focuses on achieving the objectives of developing economic and social cohesion in line with the goals set out in the 2020 Strategy. To accomplish the mission, it projects the processes and objectives that lead to the development of society. The students are at the centre of university’s concerns, so goals, action plans, policies, developed strategies, and applied principles serve their interests.
As a European member state, Romania must implement the programs designed in the European Areas of Higher Education and Research and meet the objectives of the Union’s agenda.
Education and Training 2020 seeks lifelong learning for EU citizens, improving the quality and efficiency of the education system, promoting social cohesion, active citizenship, and stimulating creativity, innovation and entrepreneurship in education.
The NUSTPB will propose for approval to the university’s senate a new strategy that seeks the following: 1) Maintain and develop skills in fundamental and engineering sciences, indispensable for the sustainability of technological development;2) Develop soft skills, social and relational skills; 3) Personal development of students; 4) Encourage the learning of modern languages; 5) Encourage student participation in mobility programs; 6) Ensure ongoing dialogue with students; 7) Encourage extracurricular activities; 8) Develop volunteering; 10) Encourage graduates with the best professional results in becoming teachers.

The NUSTPB will propose for approval to the university’s senate a new strategy that seeks the following: 1) Maintain and develop skills in fundamental and engineering sciences, indispensable for the sustainability of technological development;2) Develop soft skills, social and relational skills; 3) Personal development of students; 4) Encourage the learning of modern languages; 5) Encourage student participation in mobility programs; 6) Ensure ongoing dialogue with students; 7) Encourage extracurricular activities; 8) Develop volunteering; 10) Encourage graduates with the best professional results in becoming teachers.

entityDescription:
The Pomurje Science and Innovation Center was founded as a public research institute in 2022. In a way, we are just beginning the journey of discovering the new and the unknown. And yet we have no time to grow up, because we are thrown into global chaos, which does not allow time for carelessness, playing in the sandbox and discovering the "correct" path. We face a set of challenges that we must meet if we want to justify our existence and the trust that has been placed in us.

On this basis, we want to establish Pomurje as an equal research region, whose scientific discoveries are judged only through the scientific method and not through the prism of centralism and the "political right" to scientific existence. The creation of the Pomurje Science and Innovation Center is proof that the state recognizes the scientific potential of Pomurje, which needs to be exploited.

Research activity takes place in several different forms. Depending on the organizational form, this includes basic research work, which researchers perform as their primary activity within the scope of their employment, then there are research projects and programs, which take place on the basis of applications for relevant tenders, whereby projects are, in principle, research activities with a target orientation in a shorter period of time, while the programs are basic research lasting longer.

entityDescription:
KEKO Equipment is a medium-sized company that ranks among the world leaders in manufacturing advanced equipment for producing multilayer passive ceramic electronic circuits and other layer-based technologies. With 25 years of experience in the field, we have developed comprehensive expertise in designing and manufacturing both individual machines and complete, fully automated production lines.
Our company's origins trace back to when we operated as part of the former ISKRA consortium. Since becoming privately owned in 1995, we have built our success on a foundation of highly skilled and motivated engineers who drive our continuous innovation. Today, we serve global markets across Europe, Asia, America and Australia with our proprietary technologies.
At KEKO, we combine our extensive knowledge of established manufacturing processes with the flexibility to develop customized solutions tailored to our clients' specific requirements. Our capabilities span the entire spectrum from conventional production methods to cutting-edge applications in LTCC (Low-Temperature Co-fired Ceramic) and HTCC (High-Temperature Co-fired Ceramic) technologies.
To demonstrate our technical capabilities, we maintain a fully equipped demonstration room where clients can see prototype parts being manufactured using various multilayer technologies. This hands-on experience allows potential partners to evaluate our equipment's performance with actual LTCC, HTCC and other advanced ceramic components.
While our core focus remains on ceramic circuit manufacturing, we have successfully expanded into related fields including fuel cell production equipment. Our ability to adapt to market needs has made us a trusted supplier to several world-renowned manufacturers in these sectors.
What truly sets KEKO apart in the global marketplace is our unique combination of:
Deep technical expertise in multilayer technologies
Exceptional flexibility in equipment design
Continuous innovation driven by our engineering team
Comprehensive demonstration and prototyping capabilities
These strengths have earned our brand worldwide recognition and enabled us to develop successful technological solutions for diverse industrial applications. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction remains the cornerstone of our business philosophy as we continue to push the boundaries of multilayer manufacturing technology.

entityDescription:
Rinicom Ltd, based in the UK, is a leading provider of innovative wireless broadband communication solutions. Our expertise lies in supporting first responders, enhancing video surveillance capabilities, and advancing digital TV broadcasting technologies. 

Established in 2002, we have built a strong reputation with a diverse portfolio of cutting-edge products, including COFDM IP mesh radios and an extensive range of optical and thermal cameras, designed for both large-scale and small-scale deployments. Also, our advanced video analytics solutions feature a robust library of detection, classification, and tracking technologies, delivering exceptional performance across a variety of applications. 

We listen to our customers and over the last four years, have collaborated with multiple law enforcement agencies across Europe to develop, test, and validate emergency and community-focused software platforms and mobile apps. These solutions are designed to improve communication and collaboration, prevent crime, build trust, increase accountability, and provide critical support during both large- and small-scale disasters. 

Rinicom has proven its dedication to research, development, and innovation by participating in multiple international projects under prestigious programmes such as FP7, Horizon 2020, Eurostars, Innovate UK, and NATEP. These are complemented by numerous internal and commercial development initiatives, underscoring our commitment to pushing the boundaries of technology. 

We're proud to have been awarded the prestigious Queen’s Award for Enterprise twice, in 2013 and 2018, both times for International Trade. This award, based on a recommendation from the Prime Minister, is one of the highest accolades a UK business can receive, highlighting our dedication to global excellence. Our mission is to become the leading provider of state-of-the-art technical solutions, enabling our customers to rapidly and profitably deploy the best possible solutions.

entityDescription: Hala Systems is a technology company focused on enhancing civilian protection, humanitarian response, and accountability processes through advanced monitoring, early warning, and situational awareness tools. With operations based in Portugal and spanning multiple conflict-affected regions, Hala designs and deploys AI-enabled systems that support timely decision-making in unstable environments. The company’s services include remote sensing and event detection, data collection, analysis, and preservation for accountability and civilian protection actors, and technical support for humanitarian and stabilization actors.

entityDescription: The Hungarian Space Research Nonprofit Ltd. (Magyar Űrkutatás Nonprofit Kft.) was founded in 2024 to educate high school and university students in the field of space research. Its widespread popularity and interdisciplinary nature make it an ideal tool for STEM education. Our team offers a range of theoretical and practical programs, including initiatives focused on CanSat and CubeSat technology. We strongly believe that our educational mission fills a critical gap in Hungary, regarding fields directly connected to and even those beyond space research. We are eagerly building domestic and international partnerships to inspire and equip the next generation while advancing space technology.

description:
At RobNav GmbH, we are a pioneering startup dedicated to transforming the future of aerospace and defence by developing robust navigation, guidance, and control systems. Our mission is to create innovative and reliable solutions that support the next generation of rocket launchers in Europe. RobNav GmbH was founded in July 2024 in Nuremberg, Germany.

Although we are an emerging company, our team is not just a group of experienced engineers but a collective of passionate individuals with deep expertise in navigation and control systems. We are driven by a relentless commitment to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, leveraging the latest technological advancements to design systems that will not just meet, but exceed the needs of tomorrow’s aerospace and defense industries.

entityDescription: AUTONOMA is a deep-tech start-up company focusing on advanced capabilities for unmanned systems. We develop cutting-edge software solutions for AI based autonomous decision-making, planning and perception for unmanned systems. Those solutions aim to increase the autonomy and capabilities of unmanned systems and, therefore, increase the system’s performance while reducing the required human effort for the system’s operation. AUTONOMA was founded with the aim to develop and commercialize innovative and high-end technology solutions for unmanned vehicles, by leveraging on the strong technological backgrounds of its team. Those products shall contribute to the innovation growth of multiple innovative and disruptive domains, like swarming, autonomous operations, and decision making.
